Shopping Instructions: Note!Note!The Products Sold In This Store Only Contain Display Boxes, And Do Not Contain Building Block Model Toys.

Description:

Perfect For Protecting And Displaying Valuables At Home Or In Commercial Environments

Internal Size/Length, Width And Height: 25 * 25 * 40cm

You Can Learn How To Assemble From The Video And Packaging Instructions On The Product Page.If You Encounter Any Problems, Please Contact Customer Service.
